title: 第2584章 先天逆脉圣体第2583章 再次炼丹
content_zh:
张楚再次炼丹，依旧是羊头小老大出主意，把各种手法相互融合，期间不断变换气劲运转方向。
而云翁城三怪则是暗自高兴，以他们的修为来说，远距离观察张楚炼丹，并不会遗漏什么，反倒是少了别人打扰的机会。
而这一次，左七渡确实没理由阻挡了。
最终，张楚的这一炉丹药炼制成功，可以辅助张楚和童青山四次幽觉的宝药，恰好两颗。
花婆婆看到那丹药之后，立刻心中好奇，低声自语：“嗯？那是什么丹药，竟然需要三味五次变异的药材，料想效果应该不凡。”
病鬼也是眼中露出奇异之色，很想知道那两颗丹药是什么。
不过就在这时，左七渡的声音传入了另外三怪的耳中：“诸位，千万别打扰张楚先生，否则，我不介意动手。”
花婆婆哼了一声：“多管闲事，病的不轻！”
病鬼则是说道：“有意思，刚刚他炼制的那颗丹药，似乎很有意思。”
至于欢猴，已经重新烧制了丹炉，准备再次偷师了。
……
于嫣早就准备好了密室，在小院地下一层，四面石壁，门户厚实，隔音隔光。
两人不打算让别人看到自己的突破过程，于是下入密室之中。
密室之中，张楚叮嘱了童青山一句：“一旦出现异象，立刻打断，不要介意一步幽的共振，那些没多大用。”
童青山点了点头，把丹药送入口中。
张楚也同时服下了自己的那枚。
药力入体的瞬间，两人的幽力像熔岩一样翻涌起来，在经脉中反复冲刷。
密室中的幽力浓度陡然升高，空气都变得黏稠了几分。
两人身上的幽力开始变异，那些幽力，竟然浮现出铠甲的雏形，又散去，又凝聚，不断反复。
两个时辰之后，密室的门开了。

张楚和童青山走出密室的时候，气息平稳内敛，体表没有任何异样的光泽，只是脚步比以前更加沉稳了几分。
两人抵达了四次幽觉，没有保密，也没有引动任何异象。
但两人十分高兴，四次幽觉之后，幽力再次变异，比之前凝实了数倍。
并且入门幽功里面记载的一些特殊招式，现在终于可以学习了。
不过两人并没有在院子里演练，只是对视了一眼，各自点了点头，一切尽在不言中。
四怪都感知到了张楚和童青山突破的气息，但他们并没有在意。
花婆婆端着茶杯，稍稍点评了一句：
“四次幽觉就要依赖药草，恐怕实力有限，未来成就有限。”
病鬼用手帕掩着嘴咳嗽了一声，没说话，但摇摇头，显然对张楚和童青山如此突破，有些不以为然。
欢猴也摇了摇头，尖声道：“如此轻易幽觉，怕是与名门无缘了。”
左七渡也叹了一口气，感慨道：“这两人在修行一途上确实不强，但转念一想，他们是做丹药的，也不需要那么扎实的修行功底。”
第三天一大早，左公就带着左苒来到了小院。
左苒一身白衣，眼睛清亮，走路平稳了。
content_en:
Zhang Chu made alchemy again, and it was still the sheep-headed boss who came up with the idea, integrating various techniques with each other, and constantly changing the direction of energy movement during the process.
The three monsters of Yunweng City were secretly happy. Considering their cultivation level, they would not miss anything when observing Zhang Chu's alchemy from a distance. On the contrary, they would have less chance of being disturbed by others.
But this time, Zuo Qidu really had no reason to stop him.
In the end, Zhang Chu's furnace of elixirs was successfully refined, and there were exactly two elixirs that could assist Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan's four sleepless nights.
After Granny Hua saw the elixir, she was immediately curious and whispered to herself: "Huh? What kind of elixir is that? It actually requires three flavors and five mutations of medicinal materials. The effect should be extraordinary."
The sick ghost also had a strange look in his eyes, wanting to know what those two pills were.
But at this moment, Zuo Qidu's voice reached the ears of the other three monsters: "Everyone, please don't disturb Mr. Zhang Chu, otherwise, I don't mind taking action."
Granny Hua snorted: "If you meddle in other people's business, you will get seriously ill!"
The sick ghost said: "Interesting. The pill he refined just now seems very interesting."
As for Huanhou, he has re-fired the alchemy furnace and is ready to steal his master again.
…
Yu Yan had already prepared a secret room, which was on the underground floor of the small courtyard. It was surrounded by stone walls, the door was thick, and it was soundproof and lightproof.
The two of them didn't want others to see their breakthrough process, so they went into the secret room.
In the secret room, Zhang Chu warned Tong Qingshan: "Once a strange phenomenon occurs, interrupt it immediately. Don't mind the resonance of Yiyi You, they are of little use."
Tong Qingshan nodded and put the elixir into his mouth.
Zhang Chu also took his own.
The moment the medicine entered the body, the two people's ghost energy surged up like lava, washing through their meridians repeatedly.
The concentration of Youli in the secret room suddenly increased, and the air became a little thicker.
The ghost power on the two people began to mutate, and the ghost power actually appeared in the rudiment of armor, dissipating, condensing, and repeating again and again.
Two hours later, the door to the secret room opened.
When Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan walked out of the secret room, their auras were calm and restrained, and there was no strange luster on their bodies, but their steps were a little more steady than before.
The two of them arrived at the Netherworld four times without keeping any secrets or triggering any strange phenomena.
But the two of them were very happy. After four sleeps, the power of the ghost mutated again, becoming several times stronger than before.
And some of the special moves recorded in the introductory ghost skills can now finally be learned.
However, the two of them did not practice in the yard. They just looked at each other and nodded, saying nothing.
The four monsters all sensed the aura of Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan's breakthrough, but they didn't pay attention.
Granny Hua held the teacup and commented briefly:
"You have to rely on medicinal herbs for the fourth time. I'm afraid your strength is limited and your future achievements will be limited."
The sick man covered his mouth with a handkerchief and coughed. He said nothing, but shook his head, obviously disapproving of Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan's breakthrough.
Huanhou also shook his head and said sharply: "I am afraid that I will miss the opportunity to be a famous family so easily."
Zuo Qidu also sighed and said with emotion: "These two people are indeed not strong in cultivation, but when I think about it, they are making elixirs, and they don't need such a solid foundation in cultivation."
Early on the third day, Zuo Gong took Zuo Ran to the small courtyard.
Zuo Ran was dressed in white, her eyes were clear, and she walked steadily.
